help:
VidShrink {0}: shrink a video to a size or a quality, without the window.

Usage:
  vidshrink kucult <input> --hedef 25MB | --kalite N [options]
  vidshrink plan <input> --hedef 25MB | --kalite N [options]
  vidshrink izle <folder> --cikti <folder> --hedef 25MB | --kalite N [options]
  vidshrink donustur <input> [--kap mp4] [--kodek libx264] [convert options]
  vidshrink kaydet [--sure SEC] [--cikti PATH] [--ayarlar FILE] [--json]
  vidshrink denetim record-start | record-stop | status [--json]
  vidshrink teslim <project.vsproj.json> [--cikti PATH] [--kip MODE] [--json]
  vidshrink profiller [--disa-aktar FILE [--profil ID]...]
  vidshrink tamamlama bash | zsh | fish | powershell

Commands:
  kucult (shrink)   Encode the input. Progress goes to stderr, the result to stdout.
  plan              Print the plan and the ffmpeg arguments. Nothing is encoded.
  izle (watch)      Shrink every new video in a folder into the output folder. A file is taken
                    once its size and time stay unchanged over two scan intervals - the third scan
                    takes it - and it is not locked for writing. A file that changes while it is shrunk is tried again.
                    Files are noted in .vidshrink-izle.json and not shrunk again after a restart;
                    when the folder is read-only the note goes to the output folder. A failed
                    file is tried once more on the next start; delete the state file to redo all.
                    Ctrl+C stops cleanly.
  donustur (convert) Convert the input with the Convert tab's choices: container, codec,
                    quality, size, frame rate, audio. The ffmpeg arguments are the tab's own.
  denetim (control) Start or stop the open window's recording, or ask its status. The window
                    must be started with --control-channel; otherwise the command is refused.
  kaydet (record)   Record the screen with the recorder's saved settings, without the window. It
                    ends when the time limit runs out or on Ctrl+C; either way the file is closed and written.
  teslim (export)   Export an editor project (.vsproj.json) without the window: every clip, text,
                    music track and added source in the project, merged into one file.
  profiller (presets) List the preset library. --disa-aktar FILE writes your own profiles to a
                    file the window can import; --profil ID (repeatable) picks some of them.
  tamamlama (completion) SHELL
                    Print the Tab completion script for bash, zsh, fish or powershell.

Options:
  --dil, --lang CODE        Interface language for this run: en | tr. Default: the system language.
  --hedef, --target SIZE    Target size: 25MB, 25, 1.5GB.
  --kalite, --quality N     Target quality score, 1-100. The size is derived from it.
  --kodek, --codec C        auto | h264 | hevc | av1 | vp9 (webm). Default auto.
  --crf N                   Lock the quality value, 0-63. It overrides the plan own CRF.
  --on-ayar, --preset NAME  Lock the encoder preset (slow, veryfast, p5, 8...). The name has to
                            belong to the chosen codec, otherwise the plan drops it.
  --modul, --modulus N      Round scaled edges down to a multiple of this: 2 | 4 | 8 | 16.
                            Default 2. A larger modulus is for old hardware encoders and crops the
                            edge a little more.
  --cikti, --output PATH    Output file; the extension is .mp4, .mkv, .webm or .mov. Default
                            <input>_shrunk beside the input: the extension follows the profile's
                            container, otherwise the codec (vp9: .webm). A source already under the
                            target is copied as it is and keeps its own extension.
                            izle: the output folder, required.
  --json                    Write the result as JSON on stdout. izle: one object per line (NDJSON).
                            Progress on stderr becomes one JSON object per line (NDJSON) too.
  --olcumsuz, --no-measure  Skip the probe encodes; plan from the source bitrate.
  --vmaf                    Measure VMAF on the finished file when ffmpeg has libvmaf.
  --olcerek-ara, --search-by-measure
                            With --kalite: search the target by measuring short sample encodes, at most 4 rounds.
  --hizli, --fast           Prefer the fast hardware path, like the window's GPU box.
  --oncelik, --priority P   Encode process priority: normal, below-normal (normalin-alti) or low (dusuk).
  --is-parcacigi, --threads N
                            Encoder thread limit (-threads N). Written only for libx264 and
                            libvpx-vp9; other encoders ignore the limit and get nothing.
  --kes, --cut FROM-TO      Shrink only this range; the target size applies to the range's output.
                            Ends take seconds, clock form (0:10) or frames: --kes 300f-900f.
                            Ends are seconds or clock time: 10-40, 0:10-0:40, 90- (to the end).
                            Chapter markers are dropped in a range encode.
  --bolum, --chapters N     Builds the range from the source's chapter marks: 2 or 2-4. Cannot
                            be given with --kes.
  --tarama, --scan          Prints the source's title inventory and stops; nothing is encoded.
  --baslik, --title N       Picks the title with this number. Default: the first title.
  --ana-icerik, --main-feature
                            Picks the longest title. Cannot be combined with --baslik.
  --asgari-sure, --min-duration SEC
                            Drops titles shorter than this from the inventory.
  --azami-sure, --max-duration SEC
                            Drops titles longer than this from the inventory.
  --suzgec, --filters SPEC  Picture filters, comma separated: crop=W:H:X:Y, pad=T:B:L:R,
                            denoise=nlmeans|hqdn3d[:light|medium|strong],
                            sharpen=light|medium|strong, deblock, deband, gray, detelecine,
                            chroma-smooth=light|medium|strong,
                            rotate=clock|cclock|180|hflip|vflip, deinterlace=auto|on|off,
                            colorspace=bt709|bt601.
  --profil, --profile ID    Applies a profile from the preset library.
                            Flags given by hand override the profile.
                            Lists the library: vidshrink presets
  --profil-dosyasi, --preset-file PATH
                            Reads profiles from a VidShrink or HandBrake preset file; they are
                            searched before the library. With one profile in the file, --profil
                            is not needed; --profil also takes the preset name.
  --kirp, --crop            Detects black bars and crops the rectangle it finds.
                            Given together with --suzgec crop=, the manual value wins.
  --kirpma-kipi, --crop-mode MODE
                            Crop mode: auto | conservative | none | custom. auto crops the rectangle
                            most samples agree on (same as --kirp). conservative crops only the edges
                            that no sample counted as picture. none does not crop. custom uses only
                            --suzgec crop= and requires it. A flag that contradicts the mode is an error.
  --ses-kodek, --audio-codec C
                            Codec of re-encoded audio: aac | ac3 | eac3 | flac. flac is lossless;
                            it falls back to the default codec when the container cannot carry it
                            or its 16-bit ceiling does not fit 15% of the target.
  --ses-normal, --loudnorm  Normalise loudness of re-encoded audio (EBU R128, -24 LUFS).
  --ses-temizle, --denoise  Reduce steady background noise in re-encoded audio (afftdn).
  --ses-kazanc, --gain DB   Fixed gain on re-encoded audio, -20 to 20 dB. A copied track is unchanged.
  --ses-hizi, --arate KHZ   Sample rate of re-encoded audio: 8 | 11.025 | 12 | 16 | 22.05 | 24 | 32 |
                            44.1 | 48 (kHz, or Hz: 44100) | auto. ac3/eac3 take 32, 44.1 and 48;
                            Opus only 48. A rate the codec cannot write stops the command.
  --ses-drc, --drc N        Dynamic range compression scale for an AC-3/E-AC-3 source, 0 to 4
                            (0 off, 1 the stream's own values). It is a decoder setting; with any
                            other source audio it does nothing and a note says so.
  --altyazi, --subtitle FILE
                            Adds a .srt/.ass/.ssa/.vtt file as a subtitle track. Repeatable.
                            MP4 turns it into mov_text, MKV keeps it as is. The language comes
                            from the name: film.tr.srt.
  --yan-altyazi, --sidecar-subtitles
                            Also adds the subtitle files beside the input with the same name.
  --ses-dosyasi, --audio-file FILE
                            Adds an audio file (.aac/.ac3/.eac3/.flac/.m4a/.mka/.mp3/.ogg/.opus/
                            .wav/.wma) as a second audio track beside the source's audio. It is
                            always re-encoded and its bitrate counts toward the target size; if it
                            is longer than the video it is cut at the video's length. The language
                            comes from the name: music.en.mp3.
  --ses-degistir, --replace-audio
                            Puts the --ses-dosyasi file in place of the source's audio instead of
                            beside it.
  --yak, --burn N           Burns the source's subtitle N (1-based) into the picture. A text
                            subtitle is drawn, an image subtitle (PGS, VOBSUB, DVB) is overlaid;
                            this is how an image subtitle MP4 cannot carry stays in the output.
  --yak-srt, --srt-burn FILE
                            Burns an external .srt file into the picture; it is not added as a
                            subtitle track. The file has to be UTF-8. Text is drawn after the
                            crop and before scaling.
  --yak-ass, --ssa-burn FILE
                            Burns an external .ass or .ssa file into the picture with its styles.
                            Give only one of --yak, --yak-srt and --yak-ass.
  --yak-yazi-tipi, --burn-font NAME
                            Font of the burned text subtitle (letters, digits, space, - _ .).
  --yak-boyut, --burn-size N
                            Size of the burned text subtitle, 6 to 200 (SRT default is 16).
  --yak-kutu, --burn-box
                            Draws an opaque box behind the burned text subtitle. These three need
                            --yak, --yak-srt, --yak-ass or --altyazi-tara; image subtitles ignore them.
  --altyazi-dil, --subtitle-lang LIST
                            Carries only the source subtitles in these languages, comma
                            separated: tr,en or tur,eng. Files given with --altyazi are not filtered.
  --ilk-altyazi, --first-subtitle
                            Carries only the first source subtitle (the first one in
                            --altyazi-dil when both are given).
  --altyazi-tara, --subtitle-scan
                            Foreign audio search: burns the forced subtitle; without a
                            forced flag it counts subtitle packets and burns the sparse track.
  --meta-yok, --no-metadata Does not carry the source's container tags (title, comment, date).
                            Track language and track name stay.
  --sabit-kare, --cfr       Writes the output at a constant frame rate: every frame at an equal
                            interval, missing frames duplicated, extra ones dropped. The rate is
                            the plan's rate; --kare-hizi caps it.
  --tavan-kare, --pfr       Keeps the source's variable frame timing and only drops frames that
                            come faster than --kare-hizi. Needs --kare-hizi; cannot be given
                            with --sabit-kare.
  --kare-hizi, --fps N      Frame rate ceiling, 1 to 240. No effect when the source is slower;
                            the engine may go below it for the budget. Without a mode it means
                            --tavan-kare.
  --aralik, --interval SEC  izle: seconds between scans, also the settle time. Default 2.
  --bir-kez, --once         izle: stop once the files present are done.
  --gunluk, --log           Prints the diagnostic log: the last runs' command, versions and
                            ffmpeg's last error lines. Paths are reduced to file names.

donustur options:
  --kap, --container C      mp4 | mkv | webm | mov | avi | gif | mp3 | m4a | wav | flac | webp | avif |
                            mxf | png | jpg | opus | ogg | aiff | ac3. Default: the --cikti extension, else mp4.
  --kodek, --codec C        The tab's video codecs: libx264 (default), libx265, libvpx-vp9, libsvtav1,
                            copy, prores_ks:proxy|lt|standard|hq|4444, dnxhd:dnxhr_lb|sq|hq|hqx|444,
                            h264_nvenc, hevc_nvenc, av1_nvenc, h264_qsv, hevc_qsv, av1_qsv, h264_amf,
                            hevc_amf, av1_amf. Short names: h264, hevc, vp9, av1, prores, dnxhr.
  --crf N                   Quality value in the codec's range. Default 23.
  --bit-hizi, --bitrate K   Video bitrate in kbps instead of CRF, 50-200000.
  --cozunurluk, --resolution R
                            Height (720), WIDTHxHEIGHT (1280x720) or kaynak (source, default).
  --kare-hizi, --fps N      Output frame rate, 1-240, or kaynak (source, default).
  --ses-kodek, --audio-codec K
                            aac (default) | libopus | libmp3lame | pcm_s16le | flac | copy | none | ac3 | eac3.
  --ses-bit-hizi, --audio-bitrate K
                            Audio bitrate in kbps, 8-1536. Default 128.
  --kes, --cut FROM-TO      Convert only this range; same forms as kucult.
  --meta-yok, --no-metadata Does not carry the source's container tags.
  --etiket-baslik, --tag-title T
                            Container title tag. Also --etiket-sanatci (--tag-artist),
                            --etiket-yil (--tag-year), --etiket-yorum (--tag-comment). An empty value writes no key.
  --kapak, --cover FILE     PNG or JPEG cover: an attachment in MKV, a cover track in MP4 (video copy only).
  --onar, --repair          Remux that drops corrupt packets, rebuilds missing timestamps and starts at
                            zero. Without --kap, --kodek, --ses-kodek: MKV, video and audio copied.
  --bolum-ekle, --add-chapter TIME=NAME
                            Replaces the source chapters with this list; repeatable: --bolum-ekle 0=Intro
                            --bolum-ekle 1:30=Main. Times count from the source start; --kes shifts them.
  --bolumsuz, --no-chapters Writes the output without chapters. mp4, mkv and mov only, like --bolum-ekle.
  --ek-arguman, --extra-args "ARGS"
                            Extra ffmpeg options, written just before the output path:
                            "-tune film -g 120". Quotes keep spaces. -i, -y, -n, -f and
                            -progress are refused, as is a stray value that would be a second output.
  --cikti, --output PATH    Output file; png and jpg write a folder of frames. Default
                            <input>_converted beside the input.
  --json                    Result as JSON on stdout, progress as NDJSON on stderr.

kaydet options:
  --sure, --duration SEC    Recording length: seconds or a clock time (90, 1:30). Without it the saved
                            limit holds; without that the recording ends on Ctrl+C.
  --cikti, --output PATH    Recording file; the extension .mp4, .mkv, .mov or .gif picks the container.
                            Default kayit_<stamp> in the recorder's folder.
  --ayarlar, --settings FILE
                            Recorder settings file to read. Default the window's recorder-settings.json;
                            without it, the first-run defaults.
  --json                    Result as JSON on stdout, stage as NDJSON on stderr.
                            On Windows capture is gdigrab: first screen only, or the saved region or window.

teslim options:
  --kip, --mode MODE        hizli | akilli | tam (fast | smart | full). Default: the mode saved in
                            the project. fast cuts at keyframes, smart re-encodes only the cut edges.
  --cikti, --output PATH    Exported file. Default <source>-duzenlenmis beside the first source.
  --meta-yok, --no-metadata The exported file does not carry the source's container tags.
  --json                    Result as JSON on stdout, stage and progress as NDJSON on stderr.
                            A source changed or missing since the project was saved stops the export (exit 1).

Exit codes:
  0   Done, size inside the band (or the source was already small enough).
  2   Done, but under the band: quality was saturated, the smaller file was kept.
  3   The target could not be met: the size ceiling was exceeded.
  4   izle --bir-kez: at least one file failed.
  1   Error: ffmpeg missing, unreadable input, encode failure.
  64  Wrong usage.  130  Cancelled with Ctrl+C.

error.bad-chapter: The chapter number is invalid or the source does not have it: {0}
error.chapter-and-cut: --kes and --bolum cannot be given together; both set the cut window.
error.no-chapters: The source has no chapter marks.
error.no-fps: The source frame rate could not be read; the frame form cannot be used.

error.bad-crf: CRF must be a number from 0 to 63: {0}

error.bad-profile: Unknown profile: {0}. To see the library: vidshrink presets

error.preset-file: Could not read the preset file {0}: {1}.
error.preset-file-choose: The preset file holds more than one profile; pick one with --profil: {0}
preset-file.handbrake: HandBrake preset {0}: {1} fields carried, {2} approximate, {3} dropped.
preset-file.reason.too-new: it was written by a newer VidShrink
preset-file.reason.not-preset: it holds no VidShrink or HandBrake preset
error.extra-input: Only one input file is accepted: {0}
error.tool-missing: {0} was not found. Put it on PATH or beside VidShrink.
error.same-output: The output path is the input file.
error.no-space: Not enough disk space: about {0} MB is needed.
search.no-meter: --olcerek-ara needs libvmaf in ffmpeg; the model's target is used.
result.subtitle-scan.flagged: Subtitle scan: subtitle {0} carries the forced flag; it is burned into the picture.
result.subtitle-scan.sparse: Subtitle scan: subtitle {0} has {1} packets against {2} in the fullest track of the same language; it is burned into the picture.
result.subtitle-scan.no-subtitles: Subtitle scan: the source has no subtitle that can be burned; nothing is burned.
result.burn-charset: Burned subtitle: the file is not UTF-8 and was read as {0}. If the letters come out wrong, save the file as UTF-8.
result.subtitle-scan.not-measured: Subtitle scan: the subtitle packets could not be counted; no track is picked.
result.subtitle-scan.no-candidate: Subtitle scan: no sparse track stands next to a full one in the same language; no track is picked.
result.subtitle-scan.ambiguous: Subtitle scan: more than one track looks like a foreign audio track; no track is picked. Choose one with --yak N.
result.crop-conservative-none: Crop (conservative): the samples did not agree on one bar, so no edge was cropped.
result.alignment: Alignment: source and test timestamps are {0} ms ({1} frames) apart; frames were matched by index, not by timestamp.
result.under-band: Under the band: quality was saturated and the smaller file was kept.
result.ceiling: The size ceiling was exceeded after {0} attempts; nothing was delivered.
result.ceiling-kept: The size ceiling was exceeded after {0} attempts; the smallest result ({1} MB) was delivered anyway.
plan.search: Search:    {0} MB after {1} rounds, measured {2} for {3} requested
plan.search-failed: Search:    no measurement came back; the model's target is kept
plan.frame-rate.peak: Timing:    frame rate capped at {0} fps, variable
plan.stream.audio-passthrough: the audio track is copied as it is: the container carries its codec and it stays within 15% of the target
plan.stream.audio-downmixed: a surround audio track is mixed down to stereo while it is re-encoded
plan.stream.extra-audio-dropped: only one audio track is kept; carrying all of them in MKV takes the window's 'Keep all tracks' box; the CLI has no such option
plan.stream.extra-audio-dropped-by-conta: only one audio track is kept; keep tracks is on, but the MP4/MOV container does not carry the extra tracks
plan.stream.vp9-fell-back-to-mp4: VP9 could not be used, so the video is encoded with libx264 and the output is MP4 instead of WebM
plan.stream.vp9-fell-back: VP9 could not be used, so the video is encoded with libx264 and the output is not WebM
plan.stream.text-subtitle-converted: text subtitles are carried as timed text; styling is lost
plan.stream.image-subtitle-dropped: image subtitles (PGS/VobSub) cannot be carried in MP4 and are dropped; --burn N burns one into the picture. Carrying them in MKV takes the window's 'Keep all tracks' box; the CLI has no such option
plan.stream.image-subtitle-dropped-by-co: image subtitles (PGS/VobSub) are dropped; keep tracks is on, but the MP4/MOV container does not carry them; --burn N burns one into the picture
plan.stream.subtitle-dropped-platform: a platform target always delivers MP4 without subtitles
plan.stream.keep-tracks-overridden: 'Keep all tracks' was ignored: a platform target always delivers MP4 with one audio track
plan.stream.audio-codec-not-in-container: the source audio codec cannot travel in this container, so the track is re-encoded
plan.stream.dolby-not-in-container: the chosen Dolby codec cannot travel in this container, so the track was encoded with the container's own codec
plan.stream.dolby-below-channel-floor: the audio budget falls below the chosen Dolby codec's floor at this channel count, so the track was encoded with the container's own codec
plan.stream.flac-fell-back: FLAC could not be used: the container cannot carry it or its 16-bit ceiling does not fit 15% of the target, so the track was encoded with the container's own codec
plan.stream.audio-filter-on-copy: loudness and gain cannot be applied to a copied audio track, so the track was copied unchanged
plan.stream.webm-audio-opus: WebM carries only Opus or Vorbis audio, so the track was encoded to Opus
plan.stream.webm-stream-dropped: WebM cannot carry image subtitles, cover art or attachments, so they were dropped
plan.stream.cover-dropped: This output cannot carry the cover art, so it was dropped
plan.stream.lossless-not-passed: a lossless TrueHD/DTS track is never copied; it is re-encoded
output.not-webm: WebM cannot carry {0} video, so the file is written as {1} instead of .webm

error.watch-no-output: izle needs an output folder: --cikti FOLDER.

watch.waiting: Waiting for the write to finish: {0}

watch.stopped: Watching stopped; the state file is saved.
